128: Shimshai: The king's scribe was an anti-Semite; and he was [the royal scribe] from the times of Cyrus. As it is stated in the book of Ezra (4) that he wrote an accusation against building the Temple, until Cyrus came and annulled it. And he also did this in the days of Ahasuerus, as it is stated (Ezra 4:6), "And in the reign of Ahasuerus, at the start of his reign, (he) wrote an accusation."
